why: one party (stephabegg.com): trailhead to base 0.5 hr, trailhead to bivy 8 hr + bivy to summit 1 hr (so base to summit 8.5), summit to C-J col 3 hr + col to trailhead 4.5 hr; verified 2026-11-23
one party (Avalanche Canada report, 2026-04-28): left camp below the route 06:00, top ~13:30, back at camp ~19:00; camp-to-top includes the walk from camp; verified 2026-11-23
one party (stephabegg.com, 2006): Applebee camp to summit 4 hr, summit to camp 3.5 hr; verified 2026-11-23
first-ascent party (Alpinist newswire, 2015): climbed the route in approximately 6 hours; on top 6:30 pm, back at the car 9:30 pm; verified 2026-11-23
